bands.label: Exemplar
bands.blurb: Reference-quality API operations across every facet.

providers.name: DOKU
providers.description: DOKU (PT Nusa Satu Inti Artha) is Indonesia's pioneering payment gateway, founded in 2007 and licensed by Bank Indonesia as a Category 1 Payment Service Provider. Its developer platform exposes a hosted Checkout API plus a full suite of Bank Indonesia SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) endpoints for Virtual Account, e-Wallet, Direct Debit, QRIS, and Kirim (payout/disbursement), all settling in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR).

bands.label: Strong
bands.blurb: Solid contracts, transparent operations, and an easy start.

providers.name: Komerce
providers.description: Komerce is an Indonesian end-to-end e-commerce enabler serving more than 50,000 online sellers and SMEs with an integrated suite covering fulfilment, logistics, marketplace operations, CRM, advertising and payments — Komship, Kompack, Komplace, Komchat, Komcards, Komtim, Komads and Komclass. Its developer surface is published under the RajaOngkir brand and exposes four APIs: Shipping Cost (Cek Ongkir) for domestic and international rate lookup and airway-bill tracking across 17 Indonesian couriers, Shipping Delivery (Komship) for creating orders, requesting pickup, printing labels and tracking shipments, Payment Service for Virtual Account and QRIS transactions with signed callbacks, and QRISLY for turning a static QRIS into dynamic per-transaction QRIS codes. All four authenticate with a per-product header API key issued from the Collaborator dashboard, and the delivery, payment and QRIS products run a full isolated sandbox.

bands.label: Developing
bands.blurb: Real signal across most facets with visible, nameable gaps.

providers.name: Kredivo
providers.description: Kredivo is a Southeast Asian consumer credit platform operated by FinAccel (Kredivo Group), best known for its "Buy Now, Pay Later" product offering instant real-time credit decisioning for online and offline purchases across Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand and the Philippines. For developers, Kredivo publishes the Kredivo Checkout API — a merchant-facing HTTP/JSON payment API that lets an ecommerce store, marketplace, POS or EDC terminal offer installment payment (30 days through 24 months) at checkout. The API covers 2-click redirect checkout, 0-click tokenized express checkout, dynamic and static QR checkout for physical stores, EDC terminal checkout, transaction status polling, full and partial cancellation, user credit-limit lookup, and an installment/interest calculator, with asynchronous push notifications to a merchant-supplied push_uri and a signature-key confirmation callback. Kredivo Group also operates KrediFazz (instant cash loans), Krom (digital bank), Timo and GajiGesa.

providers.name: Pintu
providers.description: Pintu (PT Pintu Kemana Saja) is an Indonesian cryptocurrency exchange and investment app founded in April 2020 and headquartered in Jakarta. Licensed as a Physical Crypto Asset Trader (PFAK) under Bappebti and now supervised by the OJK, Pintu serves more than four million retail users with spot trading, crypto futures, staking/Earn, and a self-custody Web3 wallet connecting to DeFi and NFT dApps. Beyond the consumer app, Pintu operates Pintu Pro, an institutional and partner trading platform whose HMAC-signed WebSocket + HTTP API (docs.pintu.pro) lets market makers and partners place and cancel orders and stream execution reports and trades against production and sandbox environments. Pintu has raised over 150M USD across a Lightspeed-led 35M Series A+ (2021) and a 113M Series B (2022) with Intudo, Pantera Capital, and Northstar.

providers.name: Flip
providers.description: Flip (PT Fliptech Lentera Inspirasi Pertiwi) is an Indonesian financial technology company offering low-cost interbank money transfers, bill payments, and cross-border remittance to consumers, and a "Flip for Business" (bigflip) suite of payment APIs to companies. The Flip for Business API lets businesses disburse money to any Indonesian bank or e-wallet (Money Transfer / Disbursement API), accept online payments via bank transfer, virtual accounts, e-wallets, cards, and retail outlets (Accept Payment API), and send international transfers (International Transfer API). The API is HTTP Basic authenticated with a secret key, supports IP whitelisting, idempotency keys, and signed callbacks/webhooks, and ships a sandbox environment plus WooCommerce and Magento 2 payment plugins. Flip is backed by Insight Partners, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: IDRX
providers.description: IDRX is a stablecoin pegged 1:1 to the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR), issued by a regulated Indonesian entity and available across multiple EVM chains and Solana. Its REST API lets business (organization) accounts onboard KYC-verified users, register bank accounts, and process mint (fiat IDR -> IDRX / USDT on-chain), redeem (IDRX -> fiat IDR to a bank account), and bridge (cross-chain) transactions, plus query swap rates, fees, supported bank methods, and transaction history. Requests are authenticated with an API key and an HMAC-SHA256 request signature, and settlement is confirmed via single-delivery webhooks or transaction-history polling. IDRX is a portfolio company of a16z (crypto).

bands.label: Thin
bands.blurb: Limited machine-readable signal beyond documentation a human can read.

providers.name: Shipper
providers.description: Shipper is an Indonesian technology-driven logistics aggregator that connects merchants and e-commerce sellers to hundreds of third-party courier and last-mile delivery partners through a single platform. Its services span a logistics aggregator (multi-courier rate check, order creation, pickup and tracking), nationwide fulfillment and warehousing, contract logistics, international freight forwarding, and e-commerce enablement. Developers integrate via the HTTP-based Shipper Logistics API (v3), which exposes location search, domestic pricing, order creation (including COD), shipping label and receipt generation, pickup request, and shipment status tracking, with real-time delivery-status webhooks. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners, Partech, and Prosus Ventures.

providers.name: Telkomsel
providers.description: Telkomsel (PT Telekomunikasi Selular) is Indonesia's largest mobile network operator. Through DigiHub (digihub.telkomsel.com), its API marketplace, Telkomsel exposes network and subscriber APIs to developers and enterprises - A2P SMS and USSD messaging, subscriber status checks, identity verification (NIK/KTP matching), location verification, SIM swap detection (including a CAMARA-style API), consent management, and telco-data scoring products. Telkomsel is a GSMA Open Gateway participant, launching Number Verify, SIM Swap, and Device Location network APIs alongside the other Indonesian carriers, and partners with Vonage to distribute its network APIs globally. Access requires a DigiHub account; plans range from free sandbox trials and prepaid quota packages to enterprise tier and pay-as-you-use contracts.

providers.name: Midtrans
providers.description: Midtrans is an Indonesian payment gateway (part of the GoTo Group, alongside Gojek) that lets businesses accept online payments across cards, bank transfer / virtual accounts, e-wallets (GoPay, ShopeePay, QRIS), over-the-counter outlets, and cardless credit. It exposes Snap - a hosted / drop-in checkout - and a Core API for building custom checkout flows (charge, status, cancel, expire, refund, and card / GoPay tokenization), plus Payment Link, recurring Subscriptions, and Iris for disbursements / payouts. All APIs are REST over HTTPS with separate production (api.midtrans.com) and sandbox environments, authenticated with a Server Key over HTTP Basic (key as username, empty password); a public Client Key is used for browser-side card tokenization.

providers.name: Xendit
providers.description: Xendit is a payments infrastructure provider for Southeast Asia, giving businesses in Indonesia, the Philippines, and the wider region a single REST API to accept payments, disburse funds, and manage money movement. The unified Payments API accepts virtual accounts, e-wallets (OVO, DANA, GoPay, ShopeePay, GCash, GrabPay, Maya), QR (QRIS / QR Ph), cards, direct debit, and retail outlets through Payment Requests and Payment Tokens; complementary APIs cover hosted Invoices, Payouts / disbursements, Balance, Transactions, Customers, and Refunds. All requests are authenticated with a secret API key over HTTP Basic against the base host https://api.xendit.co.

providers.name: Xfers
providers.description: Xfers is a Southeast Asian payments infrastructure company founded in Singapore in 2015 and backed by 500 Global, providing bank-transfer collection, payouts, escrow-style wallets, and lending disbursement APIs across Singapore and Indonesia. Xfers merged with Payfazz in 2022 to form the Fazz Financial Group, with its regulated Singapore dollar stablecoin and payments business continuing as StraitsX; the Xfers v3 API documentation for Singapore and Indonesia remains published at docs.xfers.io.

providers.name: GoTo Group (Gojek + Tokopedia)
providers.description: GoTo Group (PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk) is Indonesia's largest digital ecosystem, formed by the 2021 merger of ride-hailing / on-demand superapp Gojek and e-commerce marketplace Tokopedia. It operates three business pillars: On-Demand Services (Gojek — ride hailing GoRide / GoCar, food delivery GoFood, parcel delivery GoSend, logistics GoBox, courier GoSend), E-Commerce (Tokopedia marketplace and Mitra Tokopedia), and Financial Technology (GoTo Financial — GoPay, GoPayLater, GoInvestasi). In 2024 GoTo divested Tokopedia's e-commerce operations to TikTok Shop / ByteDance, retaining a 25% stake in the combined Tokopedia–TikTok Shop entity; the developer.tokopedia.com portal now redirects to TikTok Shop's partner platform. GoTo continues to operate Gojek and GoTo Financial directly. There is no single GoTo group-wide developer portal — partner integrations happen at the product level (Gojek partner programs, GoPay PSP integrations, TikTok Shop Open Platform for the former Tokopedia surface).

providers.name: Kata.ai
providers.description: Kata.ai is an Indonesian enterprise conversational-AI company that builds AI agents and chatbots for customer experience, marketing, sales, and HR across financial services, retail, healthcare, automotive, and government. Its developer-facing Kata Platform lets teams create bot projects that bundle a Bot, CMS, and a Natural Language Understanding (NLU) model, then deploy them and connect messaging channels such as LINE, Telegram, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Slack, and Qiscus. Kata.ai exposes a public REST API for managing projects, bots, deployments, environments, channels, teams, and NLUs, an NL Prediction API for entity extraction from a trained model, the kata command line tool, and the Aksara design system. Backed by 500 Global.

bands.label: Emerging
bands.blurb: More than an index entry but still mostly links rather than artifacts.

providers.name: Bandung Institute of Technology
providers.description: Institut Teknologi Bandung (ITB) is a public research university in Bandung, Indonesia, ranked #256 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. ITB operates a number of public-facing web systems including an institutional digital library (Ganesha Digital Library / GDL), an academic portal, and a campus-wide single sign-on service. As of this review ITB does not publish a dedicated developer portal or documented public API program; its machine-readable surfaces are limited to a CAS-based SSO endpoint and an institutional repository whose historical OAI-PMH/RSS endpoints no longer resolve after a platform migration. The entries below reflect only what could be verified live and publicly.

providers.name: University of Indonesia
providers.description: University of Indonesia (Universitas Indonesia, UI) is a public research university based in Depok and Salemba, Jakarta, ranked #206 in the QS World University Rankings 2025 and the highest-ranked university in Indonesia. Its public, machine-readable developer footprint is limited: UI Scholars Hub, the institutional research repository hosted on the Digital Commons (bepress) platform, exposes a live OAI-PMH 2.0 metadata interface for harvesting scholarly works, and the campus-wide Single Sign-On runs on CAS (Central Authentication Service). No public, self-service developer portal with documented REST endpoints or API keys was found; academic, library, and identity systems are gated behind institutional credentials.

providers.name: Gadjah Mada University
providers.description: Gadjah Mada University (Universitas Gadjah Mada, UGM) is a public research university in Yogyakarta, Indonesia, and is ranked #239 in the QS World University Rankings 2025. Its public, machine-consumable developer footprint is limited: the institutional repository (EPrints "repository civitas UGM") exposes a working OAI-PMH 2.0 metadata endpoint for harvesting scholarly output, and the university operates a centralized CAS single sign-on service. Most academic and administrative systems (SIMASTER, admissions) sit behind authentication, and there is no public, documented developer portal.

providers.name: Prudential plc
providers.description: Prudential plc is a life and health insurance and asset management group incorporated in England and Wales and listed on the London, Hong Kong, Singapore and New York exchanges, with its principal operating office in Hong Kong and roots in London going back to 1848. Its home market for this profile is the United Kingdom, but its book is almost entirely Asian and African: life protection, health and medical, savings and retirement, takaful, pensions and Hong Kong Mandatory Provident Funds, plus asset management under the Eastspring brand, across Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan, India, mainland China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and a dozen African markets including Kenya, Uganda, Ghana, Nigeria and Zambia. It is no longer a UK retail insurer at all - the UK and Europe business was demerged as M&G plc in 2019 and the US business as Jackson Financial in 2021 - so the familiar UK "Pru" brands at pru.co.uk belong to M&G, not to this company. Its API posture is that there is no public API posture. Prudential plc publishes no developer portal, no API reference, no downloadable OpenAPI or Swagger document and no partner integration surface of any kind: developer, developers, docs, api, apis, partners, portal and sandbox subdomains of prudentialplc.com all fail to resolve, and /developers, /api, /developer, /partners and /integrations on the corporate site all return HTTP 404. The group's stated technology strategy is inward-facing - AI, automation, cloud and a global AI Lab running over a hundred internal use cases - and its distribution is built on tied agency forces and exclusive bancassurance partnerships with banks such as Standard Chartered, CIMB, MSB, SeABank, Bank Syariah Indonesia and UOB, which are commercial and contractual relationships rather than published API programmes. The Pulse by Prudential health and wealth app onboards health-tech and wealth-tech partners (Babylon, Tictrac, Halodoc, Smarter Health, Prive Technologies, OVO, Google Cloud) but every announcement describes the arrangement in commercial terms and none exposes a developer programme, SDK or public API. No ACORD, AL3, ACORD XML or NGDS reference was found anywhere in Prudential plc's public estate. Recorded honestly as a large carrier with a fully partner-gated, non-public integration surface. One genuine machine-readable surface does exist, and it is not an API: six of the group's market operating companies - Prudential Hong Kong, Prudential Singapore, Prudential Indonesia, Prudential Vietnam, Pru Life UK in the Philippines and Prudential BSN Takaful in Malaysia - publish real first-party llms.txt documents for grounding large language models, with Prudential Vietnam declaring a per-user-agent bot access policy for gptbot, claudebot, google-extended, perplexitybot and six other crawlers. The corporate domain publishes none. Underneath that, the group runs a visibly centralised security posture: TLS 1.3 and HSTS on every market host, and one shared PowerDMARC/PowerSPF tenant with a common aggregate-report mailbox across all seven domains, at p=reject on the corporate domain and p=quarantine in the markets, with no CAA record anywhere.

providers.name: Kita Bisa
providers.description: Kitabisa is Indonesia's largest donation-based crowdfunding and mutual-aid platform, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Jakarta. It lets individuals, nonprofits, and corporations raise and give funds transparently for medical causes, disaster relief, education, and community development, and operates a dedicated Islamic-philanthropy surface for zakat, wakaf, and qurban. The group has grown beyond crowdfunding into digital fundraising services for NGOs (ngo.kitabisa.com), a CSR and social-marketing practice for corporate partners (csr.kitabisa.com), a cooperative, and the SalingJaga mutual-protection and insurance product. Kitabisa publishes no public API or developer program — there is no developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition on any Kitabisa surface, and partner integrations are arranged through business channels. It does run a substantial first-party open source estate of 75 public Go, TypeScript, and GitHub Actions repositories, plus a public responsible-disclosure program backed by an RFC 9116 security.txt.

providers.name: Satu Data Aceh
providers.description: Satu Data Aceh is a provincial government open-data portal for Indonesia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 4,176 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Satu Data Bencana Indonesia (BNPB)
providers.description: Satu Data Bencana Indonesia (BNPB) is a government agency open-data portal for Indonesia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 2,830 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Satu Data Kalimantan Timur
providers.description: Satu Data Kalimantan Timur is a provincial government open-data portal for Indonesia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 12,388 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Satu Data Semarang Regency
providers.description: Satu Data Semarang Regency is a regional government open-data portal for Indonesia running CKAN. It exposes the CKAN catalog API, a standardized machine-readable interface over approximately 467 datasets, supporting programmatic dataset search, metadata retrieval, and resource access. Because it runs CKAN, it shares a consistent API surface with every other CKAN portal, making it uniformly harvestable and integrable.

providers.name: Jala
providers.description: JALA is an Indonesian aquaculture technology company providing end-to-end solutions for the shrimp farming industry, describing itself as a fully connected system powered by data farmers can trust. It connects farmers, processors, and buyers through the JALA App for real-time pond monitoring and data analytics, the Baruni technology platform, farming supplies (post-larvae, feed, technical assistance), harvest and cold-chain logistics services, and traceable certified supply chains for processors and buyers. Backed by 500 Global, JALA operates a consumer/operator SaaS platform (app.jala.tech) rather than a public developer API program. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio-company lead and enriched by the pipeline.

providers.name: Pluang
providers.description: Pluang is an Indonesian multi-asset investment and trading platform that lets retail users invest across a single app in US stocks and ETFs (fractional from $1), Indonesian stocks, cryptocurrencies with staking, mutual funds (Reksa Dana), physical gold and silver, options, and leveraged crypto futures. Features include Auto Invest dollar-cost averaging, the Pocket portfolio bundling tool, TradingView-powered charting, USD yield products, and the Aura AI recommendation assistant. Pluang operates under OJK and Bappebti regulatory oversight across its subsidiaries and reports 12M+ users. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures its public web, legal, and security surface. Surfaced as an accel portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline.

providers.name: Amalan
providers.description: Amalan (amalan International) is an Indonesian financial-services technology company headquartered in Jakarta and registered with Indonesia's Financial Services Authority (OJK). It helps distressed consumers and small-business owners restructure and refinance credit-card debt, personal loans (KTA), online loans (pinjol), and mortgages back toward creditworthiness. Its consumer platform provides a debt-relief negotiation program, amalanPROTECT protection against unethical debt collectors, Credit Score by amalan credit-score checks and history reports, and Credit Checkup loan-rejection consultation. Amalan is not a lender and does not take deposits or originate loans. It is backed by 500 Global. The company runs a consumer web app and marketing/blog site but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Happy5
providers.description: Happy5 is a Jakarta-based employee performance management platform, operated by Happy5 For The World Pte. Ltd. and founded in 2013, that unifies goal and OKR management, project tracking, and 360-degree performance reviews in one tool for HR teams. It automatically surfaces the goals hit, projects delivered, and milestones completed inside every performance review, and integrates with tools teams already use such as Jira, Asana, Slack, and Google Sheets. Its customers span major Indonesian banks, startups, and SMEs. Happy5 is a closed SaaS product and does not publish a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, or client SDKs; this profile captures its verified public identity and web properties as a lead.

providers.name: Lamudi
providers.description: Lamudi is an online real estate classifieds marketplace focused exclusively on emerging markets, founded in 2013 and today operating consumer property portals in the Philippines (lamudi.com.ph), Indonesia (lamudi.co.id) and Mexico (lamudi.com.mx). The platform lets buyers, renters, sellers and landlords search and list houses, condominiums/apartments, land, commercial space and offices, filtered by geography, property group and operation (buy/rent). Search results pages carry area market statistics, interactive maps and nearby points of interest, alongside country-specific features such as Philippine foreclosures and home-loan comparison, Indonesian KPR mortgage simulators, and Mexican Infonavit-eligible listings and bank repossessions. Agencies and developers publish inventory through the pro.lamudi.com professional portal. Lamudi operates as part of LIFULL Connect, which supplies its legal notice, privacy policy and contact surface. Lamudi publishes no public developer API, SDK or developer portal; its notable machine-readable surface is a first-party llms.txt on each country site that documents the URL grammar of its search, new development and project pages for AI agents.

providers.name: Bank Jago
providers.description: PT Bank Jago Tbk is a technology-based digital bank in Indonesia, listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX: ARTO) and backed by investors including Ribbit Capital and GoTo. Rather than a branch network, Bank Jago is delivered through the life-centric Jago mobile application and is deeply embedded into partner ecosystems — Gojek/GoPay for payments, and Bibit/Stockbit for investing — via API-based integrations. Its Open API payment surface is exposed through Indonesia's national SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) programme, administered through the ASPI developer directory, rather than a self-hosted public developer portal. Bank Jago is regulated by the Indonesian Financial Services Authority (OJK) and Bank Indonesia. This API Evangelist profile is compiled from public sources as a fintech company lead; the bank publishes no self-hosted OpenAPI, SDK, or developer documentation at this time.

providers.name: Bibit
providers.description: Bibit is an Indonesian retail investment application that lets everyday users invest in mutual funds (reksa dana), government bonds (SBN/SBR/ORI), fixed-rate bonds, and stocks. Built for beginner investors, it uses robo-advisor technology to recommend diversified portfolios and is licensed by Indonesia's financial regulator OJK. Bibit operates within the Stockbit group and is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures. As of this profile no public developer API, SDK, or developer portal is published; this repo tracks the company's public surface (security.txt, legal, help, blog) for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Stockbit
providers.description: Stockbit (PT Stockbit Sekuritas Digital) is an Indonesian retail-investing platform and social community for the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX), letting members discuss, analyze, and trade stocks with real-time market data, fundamentals, trading ideas, news, and sentiment. The product is delivered as consumer iOS and Android apps plus a web experience, with a separate crypto brand (Stockbit Crypto). It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global. As of this enrichment pass Stockbit publishes no public developer API, developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, SDK, or .well-known discovery surface — the profile is maintained as a consumer-app company record rather than an API provider.

providers.name: GoWork
providers.description: GoWork is Indonesia's largest premium coworking and flexible office space provider, operating more than 25 locations across Jakarta, Tangerang, Surabaya, Bali, and Medan. Formed from the 2018 merger of GoWork and Rework, the company offers private offices, dedicated desks, coworking memberships, virtual offices, meeting and event spaces, plus podcast and live-streaming studios. It also bundles business services such as company incorporation, tax and accounting, visa and work-permit processing, and legal support. Members discover, book, and manage workspace through the GoWork mobile apps and web booking platform. GoWork is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Pintarnya
providers.description: Pintarnya is an Indonesian technology startup, launched in May 2022, that operates an employment and financial-services super-app for the country's blue-collar and entry-level workforce (education levels from elementary school through bachelor's degree, "SD-S1"). The platform aggregates tens of thousands of daily-updated job listings across 300+ Indonesian cities and pairs job search with Cari Cuan side-income tasks, Siap Kerja skill-building video courses, a CV builder, and an employer/recruiter posting product used by tens of thousands of companies. Pintarnya reports more than 10 million registered job seekers and is registered with Indonesia's Ministry of Labor (KEMNAKER). It is a consumer web and mobile product; no public developer API, OpenAPI description, or developer portal is published as of this profile.

providers.name: Astro
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia, astronauts.id) is an Indonesian quick-commerce grocery and daily-needs delivery service that fulfills orders in as little as fifteen minutes across the Greater Jakarta (Jadetabek) area. The consumer mobile app offers more than 15,000 SKUs spanning fresh produce, meat and seafood, frozen and prepared meals, beverages, snacks, baby and maternal care, personal care and beauty, household supplies, and the private-label Astro Goods line, operating 24/7 from a network of dark stores. Astro is venture-backed by Accel, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and Redpoint Ventures. It is a consumer B2C app and publishes no public developer API; this API Evangelist profile tracks the company as a portfolio lead.

providers.name: Astro Sea
providers.description: Astro (PT Astro Technologies Indonesia), operating at astronauts.id, is an Indonesian quick-commerce platform that delivers groceries and everyday essentials in as little as 15 minutes. Its consumer mobile apps (iOS and Android) offer more than 3,000 curated products spanning fresh produce, frozen goods, groceries, beauty, household items, and electronics, with 24/7 service across the Greater Jakarta (JADETABEK) region. Astro is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and was surfaced through that portfolio into the API Evangelist network. Astro is a business-to-consumer application company; it publishes a consumer app, a corporate site, and an RFC 9116 security contact, but does not currently expose a public developer API, OpenAPI definition, SDKs, or developer portal.

bands.label: Minimal
bands.blurb: Index entry only; little beyond a description and a link.

providers.name: Bukalapak
providers.description: Bukalapak is one of Indonesia's largest online marketplaces and all-commerce platforms, connecting millions of individual sellers, small warungs (kiosks), and buyers across the archipelago, alongside virtual products, financial services, and online-to-offline retail. Originally added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio-lead stub (backed by 500 Global), this profile has been enriched from Bukalapak's real public developer surface: a public REST API at api.bukalapak.com secured with OAuth2 via accounts.bukalapak.com, a first-party JavaScript SDK (bukalapak.js), and a large public GitHub organization. No OpenAPI/Swagger specification is currently published by the provider, so the captured artifacts (authentication, packages, domain security) are sourced from first-party repositories and live domain probes rather than derived from a spec.

providers.name: HD
providers.description: HD is an AI-native healthcare marketplace and patient-navigation platform for emerging Southeast Asia, headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Its consumer surface, HDmall, is a health, dental, aesthetics, and surgery marketplace that lets patients compare transparent pricing and book online across 30,000+ services from 3,000+ clinics and hospitals in Thailand (hdmall.co.th) and Indonesia (hdmall.id). AI-powered navigation turns patient symptoms into personalized, safety-checked care recommendations, and HDcare adds human-led, AI-assisted concierge support for complex surgical cases. The platform has navigated over 500,000 patients. HD is a consumer-facing healthtech operator with no public developer API or portal; the strongest machine-readable surface it publishes today is an llms.txt guiding LLMs to its canonical content. HD is a portfolio company of Partech, added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: HijUp
providers.description: HijUp is an Indonesia-based modest-fashion e-commerce marketplace selling Muslim women's clothing online — abayas, blouses, dresses, tunics, printed scarves, hijabs, mukena, khimar, and related accessories — aggregating a large catalog of local Indonesian modest-wear brands (over a hundred labels listed under its brands directory) into a single storefront with international shipping. The company operates a consumer-facing shopping site (product catalog, categories, cart, checkout, and customer accounts) rather than a public developer platform; it publishes no API, SDK, or developer portal at this time. HijUp is backed by 500 Global and is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a company profile. Public contact is customer@hijup.com and +6221-78-24-001.

providers.name: Bumame
providers.description: Bumame is an Indonesian healthcare provider ("Elevating Indonesian Healthcare") delivering global-standard health screening and preventive-care services to Indonesian families. It operates a network of clinics and offers medical check-up packages, laboratory testing, vaccination and boosters, maternal and child health services, early cancer screening and genetic DNA testing, vitamin infusions, home care, doctor consultations, and corporate health programs, with online appointment booking. Backed by 500 Global. Surfaced as a portfolio-company lead in the API Evangelist network; no public developer API surface has been found to date.

providers.name: Dagangan
providers.description: Dagangan is an Indonesian tech-enabled wholesale e-commerce platform serving small and medium retailers (SMEs) in tier 3-4 cities and rural areas. Through a hub-and-spoke network of 50+ micro-warehouses across remote regions, it connects large suppliers to traditional local retailers, giving them affordable mobile access to daily necessities and groceries while reducing delivery costs and supply-chain friction. The company operates a consumer/retailer Android shopping application (Dagangan Mall), is backed by 500 Global, and is recognized as a Rural Digitalization Partner of Indonesia's Ministry of Villages, Disadvantaged Regions, and Transmigration. As of this profile, Dagangan publishes no public developer API or OpenAPI specification.

providers.name: Alodokter
providers.description: Alodokter is Indonesia's leading digital health and telemedicine platform, founded in 2014 and operated by PT Alodokter Teknologi Solusi. It connects tens of millions of monthly active users with tens of thousands of licensed doctors through chat-based consultations (Tanya Dokter), online and in-person doctor appointment booking, a large library of medically reviewed health articles and a symptom and disease encyclopedia, health protection and insurance products, and a health commerce surface for medicines and health products. This API Evangelist profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and enriched from the provider's own public web surface; Alodokter does not publish a public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time, so this profile focuses on company identity, legal and support surfaces, and domain security posture.

providers.name: GetCraft
providers.description: GetCraft is a Southeast Asian creative and content-marketing marketplace, headquartered in Indonesia and backed by 500 Global, that brands itself as "The Creative Industry's Premium Directory." It connects brands and agencies with a vetted network of freelance creators and production partners ("Crafters") for content, video, design, advertising, and marketing work, spanning a talent Directory, a Jobs board, Managed project services, and a Community. Its companion publication, MarketingCraft, is a bilingual (English/Indonesian) content hub of articles, events, tutorials, jobs, and research for marketers and creators. GetCraft exposes no public developer or API surface; this record is an identity/enrichment profile.

providers.name: Imajin
providers.description: Imajin is an Indonesian online manufacturing marketplace (the "Indonesia Manufacturing Hub") that connects buyers with vetted manufacturers and machine shops through a project-based workflow: post a project, receive quotes, and track production through to delivery. It brokers rapid 3D printing and prototyping, high-precision mold and die making, SPM and custom part fabrication, mass production (stamping, plastics, and fabrication), CNC milling and turning at machining centers, and broader manufacturing projects. The platform offers an instant-quote tool, real-time project notifications, integrated company profiles, team and project management, and up-front payment handling for suppliers. Imajin is backed by 500 Global.

providers.name: Elevarm
providers.description: Elevarm is an upstream-focused agritech company founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bandung, Indonesia, that elevates smallholder horticulture farmers across West Java, Central Java, and Yogyakarta. It aggregates and supports more than 15,000 farmers with high-quality inputs (premium greenhouse seedlings, bio-based fertilizers, and environmentally friendly pest control via its NextBio line), lab-based soil testing through Klinik Tani, an AI-powered farming productivity app for land monitoring and data-driven agronomy recommendations, pro-farmer financing, and the PasarAgri commodity trading platform that links supply to business buyers. Elevarm is backed by Intudo, Insignia Ventures Partners, and 500 Global.

providers.name: Finku
providers.description: Finku is an AI-based personal finance management (PFM) mobile app from Indonesia, recognized as the number-one Indonesia PFM app and a Google Play "Best of 2025" selection with more than one million users. It helps people track expenses, set budgets, and build better money habits through manual entry, receipt and bank e-statement scanning, and FinGPT, a chat-based AI financial assistant. The app connects multiple banks and e-wallets, generates real-time interactive dashboards and reports, and runs a freemium model with a Premium tier. Finku is registered with Indonesian regulators OJK, Kominfo, AFTECH, and AFPI, and secures user data with 256-bit AES encryption. Finku is a consumer application and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal; this profile originated as a VC-portfolio lead for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Jago Coffee
providers.description: Jago Coffee is an Indonesian mobile coffee company operating a fleet of electric-vehicle coffee carts ("Jagoans") that bring freshly brewed specialty coffee, tea, and seasonal drinks directly to neighborhoods across Indonesia. Billing itself as the "#1 Cafe on Wheels," Jago lets customers order through its mobile app with no delivery fees or order minimums, paying with GoPay or OVO digital wallets, using Arabica beans sourced directly from local Indonesian farmers. Backed by 500 Global, the company is tracked in the API Evangelist network as a consumer coffee-delivery business; as of this enrichment pass it publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDK.

providers.name: Qraved
providers.description: Qraved is Indonesia's leading food discovery platform, self-described as the "No. 1 Food App for Indonesia," helping diners across Jakarta, Bali, Bandung, Surabaya, Medan and other cities explore restaurants, read reviews and dining guides, watch food videos, and connect with a community of food enthusiasts. Backed by 500 Global, Qraved operates a consumer web experience and iOS/Android mobile apps. As of this enrichment pass the company exposes no public developer API, developer portal, or machine-readable specification surface.

providers.name: Travelio
providers.description: Travelio is one of Indonesia's largest online property rental and management platforms, operated by PT Horizon Internusa Persada. It lists furnished and unfurnished apartments, houses, villas, guest houses, and hotel residences for daily, monthly, and yearly rental across 15+ Indonesian cities including Jakarta, Bandung, Surabaya, Bali, and Yogyakarta, and offers hospitality-grade property management for owners. Backed by 500 Global, Travelio runs consumer web and mobile apps but publishes no public developer API, SDK, partner integration surface, or developer portal as of this profile.

providers.name: 99.co
providers.description: 99.co (99 Group) is a Singapore-headquartered real estate technology company and one of the largest property marketplaces in Southeast Asia. Founded in 2014 by Darius Cheung, Yan Phun and Conor McLaughlin, it operates consumer property portals across Singapore and Indonesia, including 99.co and SRX.com.sg in Singapore and 99.co/id and Rumah123.com in Indonesia. The platform lets buyers, renters and agents search HDB resale flats, executive condos, condominiums, landed homes and new-launch projects for sale and rent, with map-based search, transaction data, agent directories, mortgage tools and nearby-amenity insights (MRT, schools, commute times). 99 Group is backed by investors including Sequoia Capital, 500 Global, Golden Gate Ventures, Quest Ventures and East Ventures. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; 99.co exposes consumer web products but publishes no first-party public developer API or portal at this time.

providers.name: Five Jack
providers.description: Five Jack (PT. Five Jack) is the Indonesian company behind itemku, one of Southeast Asia's largest digital-goods marketplaces for gamers. Founded in 2014 as a game price-comparison and classifieds platform, itemku grew into a full marketplace where buyers and sellers trade in-game items, currency, account top-ups, game keys, and vouchers across 200+ game categories including Roblox, Genshin Impact, Mobile Legends, Dota 2, Steam, and Growtopia. The company reached one million orders in 2018, launched its Android app and gaming blog in 2020, and became part of Bukalapak (IDX: BUKA) in May 2021. Five Jack was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network. It operates a consumer-facing marketplace and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal.

providers.name: Cosmart
providers.description: Cosmart is an Indonesian membership-only B2B e-commerce and procurement platform, founded in 2021 by Alvin Kumarga and Robert Tan, where members (individuals and SMEs) purchase their recurring daily and business needs in larger quantities at competitive prices. The platform lists over 100,000 products across categories including office supplies, electronics, household items, automotive parts, industrial equipment, furniture, and services, with nationwide delivery, flexible payment terms, and dedicated relationship managers for corporate clients. Backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Lightspeed India Partners. Cosmart does not publish a public developer program, API, or SDKs; this profile captures its identity and public web properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Touchten
providers.description: Touchten (Touchten Pte. Ltd.) is an award-winning mobile game studio headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia, and an early 500 Global (500 Startups) portfolio company. Its casual games - including Piper's Pet Cafe, Royal Garden Tales, Dessert Chain, Warung Chain Go Food Express, and the Teka-Teki Saku (TTS) crossword series - are published on the App Store and Google Play, are played by millions worldwide, and cater especially to the underserved women gamers market in the US and Europe. Touchten won the Google Play Indonesia Games Contest and received the Forbes Indonesia Rising Global Stars Award. The company publishes no developer portal or public API surface.

providers.name: Edukita
providers.description: Edukita (PT Edukita Budaya Cinta Belajar) is an Indonesian education company founded during the COVID-19 pandemic by Peter Gumulia and Sean Widjaja on the belief that high-quality education should be accessible to all. It teaches skills that matter through playful but powerful learning, delivering programs online, through six physical learning centers across Greater Jakarta (Bintaro, Bogor, BSD, Depok, Gading Serpong), and blended (Rumah Belajar Edukita). Programs span English with native speakers, early childhood development, Japanese mathematics, and professional upskilling for young students, families, adult learners, and corporate training. Edukita is a portfolio company of 500 Global. It exposes no public developer API surface at this time; this profile captures its identity and domain-security posture.

providers.name: Pashouses
providers.description: Pashouses (PT Pionir Alfa Sejahtera) is an Indonesian proptech company operating an end-to-end transactional marketplace for buying and selling ready-to-occupy residential homes across the Greater Jakarta (Jabodetabek) region — Jakarta, Tangerang, Tangerang Selatan, Bekasi, Bogor, and Depok. Founded in 2020 by Junghans Tasani and Bin Anindita, the platform combines an iBuyer model, brokerage, staging, and renovation with mortgage (KPR) origination through partnerships with major Indonesian banks (BCA, Mandiri, BSI, BRI). It offers consumer tools including a Smart Agent property assistant, a KPR mortgage calculator, and an affordability calculator. QED Investors led a $5M pre-Series B in November 2022 (its first Indonesian / Southeast Asian investment). The company exposes a consumer web marketplace only; no public developer, API, or documentation surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Aruna
providers.description: Aruna is Indonesia's largest integrated fisheries commerce platform, on a mission to make the sea a better livelihood for all by building a fair and sustainable fisheries ecosystem. Aruna connects more than 40,000 small-scale fishermen to domestic and global markets using technology, a network of processing partners, and 177+ distribution hubs (Aruna Hubs) across the Indonesian archipelago, trading 23+ seafood commodity types into 31+ countries. The company pairs commerce with sustainability work, including fisherman education, fish-population tracking, and coastal-community empowerment. Aruna is a portfolio company of Prosus Ventures and was added to the API Evangelist network as a company lead; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Ekomoditi
providers.description: eKomoditi (PT Ekomoditi Solutions Indonesia) is a Southeast Asian agriculture-technology company, founded in 2015 and based in Jakarta, that builds digital plantation-management software for oil palm, rubber, sugar, and durian estates. Its flagship Electronic Plantation Control System (ePCS) replaces paper-based field recording with a mobile in-field Android app, an eGIS geographic mapping application, mills automation, and business-intelligence analytics — capturing harvesting, fertilization, pest-management, worker, and transport data for same-day reporting, labor-fraud monitoring, quality control, and traceability. eKomoditi also offers aerial-mapping drone services, a plantation marketplace, and due-diligence consulting. The company is backed by 500 Global and ZB Capital. It does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or API documentation.

providers.name: Fairbanc
providers.description: Fairbanc (PT Fairbanc Technologies Indonesia) is a Jakarta-based digital finance platform that uses AI/ML-powered credit scoring to deliver embedded, revolving supply-chain financing and buy-now-pay-later "terms of payment" to micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) across Indonesia. Working with trusted financial institutions and distributor/supply-chain ecosystems, Fairbanc provides merchants with an instant digital facility limit and short-term working-capital liquidity at the point of purchase — with no formal loan application, smartphone, or app required — plus data intelligence and consulting that help distributors reduce bad-debt risk and grow transaction value. The company reports its terms-of-payment product drove roughly 35% distributor sales growth. This is a company profile in the API Evangelist network; Fairbanc publishes a consumer-facing marketing and onboarding site but no public developer/API program at this time.

providers.name: UrbanHire
providers.description: UrbanHire was an Indonesian all-in-one hiring and assessment platform (applicant tracking system) backed by 500 Global, designed to streamline recruitment and help employers hire the right talent. The company appears defunct - urbanhire.com has been offline behind Cloudflare (HTTP 530) with the last archived homepage from January 2021 - and it never published a public API or developer documentation. Its GitHub organization and first-party npm engineering packages remain the surviving technical footprint.

providers.name: Brik
providers.description: Brik ("[Re]Constructing Construction") is an Indonesian construction-materials company, backed by Accel, that operates concrete batching plants and supplies ready-mix concrete for building and infrastructure projects across the Greater Jakarta region, including Bekasi, Bogor, Karawang, and Bandung. Its product line spans standard ready-mix batches and higher-performance "Super Concrete" variants used for mass-concrete pours. At the time of enrichment Brik publishes no public developer API, OpenAPI specification, SDKs, or webhook surface; this record is maintained in the API Evangelist network as a company profile.

providers.name: Hangry
providers.description: Hangry is an Indonesian multi-brand virtual restaurant and cloud-kitchen company founded in 2019 and backed by 500 Global. It designs, operates, and delivers a portfolio of consumer food brands - including Moon Chicken, San Gyu, Ayam Koplo, Dari Pada, Wai Thai, Pizza Gang, and Accha - engineered to be tasty, consistent, and affordable for the mass market and sold primarily through third-party food-delivery channels. Hangry operates as a direct-to-consumer food and beverage business rather than an API or developer platform provider; it publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface. This profile was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment tracking.

providers.name: GoTo
providers.description: GoTo (PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk, IDX: GOTO) is the largest technology group in Indonesia, formed in May 2021 through the merger of the on-demand and ride-hailing pioneer Gojek and the e-commerce marketplace Tokopedia. GoTo operates a super-app ecosystem spanning on-demand services (ride-hailing, food and grocery delivery, logistics), e-commerce, and financial technology through GoTo Financial (including GoPay, one of Indonesia's leading digital wallets). The group serves Indonesia's population of more than 270 million, connecting tens of millions of consumers with millions of merchants and driver-partners, and is estimated to contribute roughly 2 percent of Indonesia's GDP. GoTo is backed by a roster of blue-chip investors including SoftBank Vision Fund, Alibaba, Google, Tencent, Temasek, and Sequoia Capital India. This company profile was surfaced as a SoftBank Vision Fund portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline. Note that GoTo Group's developer surfaces are published per product (Gojek/GoBiz, Tokopedia, GoTo Financial/Midtrans) rather than at a single group-level developer portal; this record profiles the parent holding company.

providers.name: BerryKitchen
providers.description: BerryKitchen (Berry Kitchen) was an Indonesian online catering and prepared-meal company founded in Jakarta in 2012 by Cynthia Tenggara. It took online orders for lunch boxes and bento meals aimed at office workers across Jabodetabek, and ran the full chain itself - supplier sourcing, cooking, packaging and last-mile delivery - rather than acting as a marketplace. It was backed by East Ventures and 500 Startups (now 500 Global) and was acquired by Yummy Corp in 2019, with the team folded into Yummy Corp's Yummybox unit and the founder subsequently exiting. BerryKitchen never published a public API, developer portal or SDKs, and its domain is no longer operated by the company, so this profile is catalogued for historical and VC portfolio-graph purposes only.

providers.name: Brodo
providers.description: Brodo (PT Brodo Ganesha Indonesia) is an Indonesian direct-to-consumer footwear and menswear brand founded in Bandung, selling shoes, apparel, and accessories through its official webstore at bro.do. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. Brodo runs a consumer e-commerce storefront on a third-party commerce platform (Plugo) with local Indonesian payment rails (NicePay); it publishes no first-party developer API, OpenAPI, developer portal, SDK, or public integration surface at this time, so there are no API artifacts to enrich beyond this company profile.

providers.name: eFishery
providers.description: eFishery is an Indonesian aquaculture technology ("fishtech") company founded in 2013 in Bandung by Gibran Huzaifah and Chrisna Aditya. Its platform combined an IoT smart auto-feeder (eFeeder) that dispenses feed to fish and shrimp ponds and streams pond telemetry to a smartphone app, with an integrated services layer: eFisheryKu / eFarm farm-management software, eFund (including the Kabayan "pay later" financing product) linking smallholder farmers to lenders, and eFresh / eMart marketplaces connecting farmers to feed suppliers and downstream buyers. The company raised a $90M Series C (2022) and a $200M Series D (2023) at a unicorn valuation, backed by investors including 500 Global, Aqua-Spark, SoftBank Vision Fund 2, Temasek, and Northstar. In late 2024 an audit alleged large-scale financial-statement fraud dating to 2018; both founders resigned and the company underwent multiple rounds of layoffs and restructuring through 2025. This record was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; eFishery exposes no public developer API or developer portal, and its primary efishery.com domain currently resolves to a parked/forwarding host.

providers.name: Ula
providers.description: Ula was a B2B wholesale commerce platform for small neighborhood retail shops (warungs), providing supply chain technology, inventory management, and credit access across Indonesia, India, and Singapore. Backed by Prosus Ventures, Ula closed its core operations in late 2023 and ula.app now hosts a retrospective of the company. No public API, developer portal, or SDKs were ever published, and no developer subdomains resolve.

providers.name: YourPay
providers.description: YourPay is an Indonesian fintech mobile application that helps overseas workers and their families send money to Indonesia, pay bills (electricity, BPJS), buy phone credit, top up e-wallets, make QRIS payments, and shop online. It is registered with Bank Indonesia as a Payment Service Provider (Kategori Izin 1, license 23/678/DKSP/Srt/B) and monitored by KOMINFO. YourPay is a consumer-facing payments app and does not currently publish a public developer portal, API reference, or OpenAPI definition. It was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Mycotech
providers.description: MYCL (Mycotech Lab) is an Indonesian biomaterials company, founded in 2015 and based in Bandung, that cultivates mushroom mycelium on agricultural waste to produce sustainable, carbon-sequestering alternatives to animal leather, plastics, and construction materials. Its flagship product is Mylea, a mycelium-based leather-like material, alongside Biobo binder board, MYCL Composite for architecture and interior design, and Mylea Sea, a seaweed-based biopolymer. A certified B Corp and Good Design Award winner backed by 500 Global and the Unreasonable Group, MYCL sells physical materials and finished goods rather than software; it publishes no public API, developer portal, or developer documentation.

providers.name: Ahlijasa
providers.description: Ahlijasa was an Indonesian on-demand home services startup founded in 2015 in the Greater Jakarta area by Jay Jayawijayaningtiyas and Made Dimas Astra Wijaya. It originally offered laundry, air-conditioning repair, and home cleaning before pivoting in late 2016 to focus exclusively on on-demand laundry by partnering with premium and traditional laundrettes to give them a digital storefront and online customer base. The company won Startup World Cup Indonesia in 2016 and raised seed funding in May 2017 from 500 Startups (500 Global), Fenox VC, and Indogen Capital, but secured no further funding afterward. Its primary domain (ahlijasa.com) now resolves to a domain-parking/for-sale page, indicating the business is no longer operating. No public API, developer portal, or machine-readable API artifacts were found for this provider during enrichment.

providers.name: Belanjaparts
providers.description: Belanjaparts is an Indonesian e-commerce platform for automotive spare parts, operating primarily as a mobile application with a searchable catalog of vehicle components, user accounts, shopping cart, order tracking, and location-based services. It serves the automotive aftermarket retail sector and is backed by 500 Global. The company was surfaced as a 500 Global portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network; it publishes no public developer, API, or integration surface at this time (consumer app and website only).

providers.name: Chickin
providers.description: Chickin is an Indonesian poultry-technology company operating a full-stack, integrated ecosystem for chicken farmers across Indonesia. It combines closed-house smart-farming hardware (IoT climate and environmental controllers), day-old-chick and feed supply, farmer financing, and guaranteed offtake and distribution of live birds, aiming to modernize and de-risk small and mid-scale poultry farming. Backed by 500 Global, Chickin runs its operations through a mobile and web application at chickin.id. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API artifacts; this profile records its public web presence and domain-security posture and remains a lead for further enrichment should a developer surface be published.

providers.name: Eatsii
providers.description: Eatsii is a Jakarta, Indonesia based foodtech startup operating a cloud kitchen platform. It runs a cloud kitchen concept that offers takeaway and delivery alongside dine-in service, and markets cloud kitchen space to F&B operators under a franchise partnership model, positioning itself as helping food and beverage companies run a more efficient kitchen in the food delivery era. The company describes itself as combining a heartfelt touch with data and business strategy, and lists 11-50 employees in Food and Beverage Services. It was surfaced through the 500 Global (500 Durians) portfolio. Eatsii publishes no developer program, public API, or technical documentation, and as of July 2026 its eatsii.com domain does not serve a live website.

providers.name: mucho
providers.description: Mucho (Mucho Indonesia) was an Indonesian social-commerce startup founded in 2018 and headquartered in South Jakarta, positioned as Indonesia's first social online shopping application and often described as an aspiring "Pinduoduo for Indonesia." Its mobile app let users buy together with friends to unlock group-buying discounts, cutting distribution layers by working directly with brand owners and pairing frictionless payment with logistics support. The company raised early / seed funding with participation from Qiming Venture Partners. Mucho has since shut down; its app is no longer distributed and the mucho.asia domain now resolves to a parked placeholder page with no product, API, or developer surface. This profile is retained as a defunct-company record surfaced through the Qiming portfolio graph.

providers.name: Pazpo
providers.description: Pazpo was an Indonesian property-technology (proptech) marketplace that billed itself as the country's first property search engine ("Mesin Pencari Properti Pertama di Indonesia"), letting users buy, sell, and rent homes, shophouses (ruko), apartments, warehouses, offices, and land across Jakarta, Tangerang, and the wider Indonesian market via web and a companion mobile app. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global (500 Startups) and added to the API Evangelist network as a lead for the enrichment pipeline. The enrichment pass found the company defunct: the pazpo.id domain no longer resolves (DNS lookup fails), and by 2024 the lapsed domain had been taken over by an unrelated Indonesian online-gambling ("togel") site. No live website, developer portal, API, SDK, or documentation surface exists to harvest; historical detail here is reconstructed from Internet Archive captures (2015-2017).

providers.name: Pinhome
providers.description: Pinhome is an Indonesian proptech real estate marketplace for smart buying, selling, and renting of houses, apartments, offices, and shop-houses (Pintar Jual Beli Sewa Rumah). The platform spans property listings and search, mortgage (KPR) and loan-takeover facilitation with partner banks, an automated property valuation tool (Pinvalue), and a marketplace of household and property services. Backed by Ribbit Capital, Pinhome operates a consumer-facing web and mobile product and does not publish a public developer API surface as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Qerja
providers.description: PT Qerja Manfaat Bangsa (Qerja) is an Indonesian human-resources company operating an end-to-end HR product ecosystem for employers, established in 2007 and later part of the PT M Cash Integrasi Tbk technology group. In 2019 it acquired Karir.com, Indonesia's first job portal (since 1998), and reports serving over 50,000 clients and 8 million member users across the country. The public presence is a corporate marketing site (qerjagroup.com) covering its HR services, clients, and user demographics; no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Samastha Synergy Pte. Ltd.
providers.description: Samastha Synergy Pte. Ltd. operates Djoin (djoin.id), positioning itself as a "digital partner for sustainable scale" that helps financial institutions and organizations in Indonesia grow through an adaptive product ecosystem. Djoin's named products are Coopmax (a platform aimed at cooperatives / koperasi), Kocek, and ProofyLink. The company runs a private backend API at api.djoin.id, which sits behind Cloudflare and returns 403 to unauthenticated requests; as of this profile there is no public developer portal, OpenAPI/Swagger definition, documentation, or SDK surface published. Samastha Synergy was surfaced as a portfolio company of 500 Global and added to the API Evangelist network for enrichment; this profile captures what is publicly verifiable from the djoin.id site and DNS/TLS probes.

providers.name: Saudara Ai
providers.description: Saudara AI is an AI-native sourcing brokerage, founded in 2024 and based in Spokane, Washington, that connects American brands with vetted Indonesian manufacturers. Buyers submit requests for quotes (RFQs) and the company pairs human brokers with AI agents that scan factories, verify certifications, benchmark pricing against market data, and prepare quotes, returning vetted supplier options within 48 hours. Saudara AI also handles quality control, logistics, improved payment terms (30/70 and net-60), and vendor financing. As of its launch the company reports having sourced over $1M for 40+ brands. It operates as a brokerage service and does not publish a public developer API, documentation, or SDKs.
